mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, conversation_json, created_at, updated_at FROM saved_conversations WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_conversations (user_id, title, conversation_json) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{conversationJson})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM saved_conversations WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
